messages:
Maria: Heads-up — planning a post-merge infra apply during the release quiet window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Networking + IAM changes. Need to decide provider pin and canary plan. Anyone object? :wave:
AJ: No objections, just flagging provider upgrade on the path. Can we pin terraform-provider-aws and do a staged provider bump after cutover?
Casey: +1 to provider pin. Also we should run a small regional canary (eu-west-1) before global shift.
deploybot: change window reserved by @Maria for 2025-11-04 02:00 UTC — no overlapping deploys allowed. CI checks required: tf fmt, tf validate, plan approval.
infra-bot: terraform plan finished (detached run) — plan summary: 8 add, 3 change, 1 delete. Preview: networking route updates, IAM role trust changes. plan link: https://ci.internal/runs/654321
Oliver: We should set an explicit rollback threshold: if p50 latency increases >30% or ERROR rate >0.5% in canary for 10m, abort and roll back. Also prepare an immediate fallback model (previous tf state snapshot).
AJ: For provider pin, propose adding this constraint to root module to avoid drift:
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  version = "~> 4.70"
}
```
Casey: Also add a provider-compatible module pin for cross-account iam module, plus a quick smoke test task: create test-role and assume it.
Maria: I'll update the runbook with rollback steps and the release notes link. Runbook checklist: 1) Lock PR merge, 2) run pb-monitor canary, 3) apply eu-west-1 only, 4) validate metrics 15m, 5) proceed to rest of regions.
AJ: Can someone add a literal tfstate snapshot job before apply? If not, we should at least create an S3 snapshot and tag it with the release id.
infra-bot: snapshot job queued -> snapshot-20251104-0200 (S3://redwood-backups/2025-11-04/).
Casey: I volunteered to own the canary validation step. Will post the smoke script here in the thread before EOD.
Maria: Thanks — assigning owners: Casey = canary validation, AJ = provider pin + plan approval, Oliver = rollback lead, me = release owner.
Oliver: I'll prepare the rollback script and a revert apply plan. Keep the apply window to 30m per region to limit blast radius.
Maria: Cool. One last note — update release notes with the IAM trust change and callout to customer teams. Link: https://docs.internal/releases/2025-11-04. :memo:
AJ: ack :thumbsup:
Casey: ack :+1:
deploybot: Reminder scheduled 30m before window start.
Maria: Great, thanks everyone. Will post final plan and smoke script tonight.
